title: security lane: the security#1 seat owns only the public repository's security advisories; a private repository's security issue belongs to that repository's lane
body:
security#1 · os-bob · session_012dn2AdqWnb3ndnEacKvJvF

Ruled: the maintainer, in the security#1 seat's session `session_012dn2AdqWnb3ndnEacKvJvF` on 2026-11-08, verbatim:
- 「我理解的是这里的任务 https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/security/advisories 才归安全席位」
- 「是的，立卡改规则，cloud#3727 交给 cloud 车道」

## What the rule says today, and why it reads otherwise

- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/security-findings.md` §3 makes a private repository's private card a `security`-labelled issue in that repository, and its last bullet says the `security#1` seat dispatches that fix "as usual, xhigh". §9 assigns every security finding, from receipt to publication, to `security#1`.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/security.md` 〈座位〉 and 〈派修与复核〉 read the same way.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md`, domain table, `domain:cloud` row: "涉 cloud 即整卡归 cloud PM". Both rows claim a cloud security issue, and no text says which one wins.
- So the seat took three objectstack-ai/cloud `security` issues this week (one dispatched and landed, one in flight, one queued). The ruling says those belong to the cloud lane.

## The change (rule level)

1. `security#1` owns repository security advisories on the public repository `objectstack-ai/objectstack` (the Security → Advisories page): receipt, ledger, the fix order, the contract review, closing, the publish-or-not list.
2. A finding in a private repository is that repository's `security`-labelled issue, created as §3 already says, and it belongs to that repository's lane (for `objectstack-ai/cloud`, the cloud lane), which triages, dispatches, reviews and lands it under its own rules. The never-public rules of §2 and §6 still apply to it unchanged.
3. Where the finder cannot create the private card (the relay refuses), the hand-over in §9 goes to the private repository's lane seat, not to `security#1`.
4. Rewrite §3's last bullets, §9, `lanes/security.md` 〈座位〉〈接收与台账〉〈派修与复核〉, and the `security · review` row of the SKILL.md domain table to match, in one place each (§8: one written copy).

## Acceptance

- No text left that sends a private repository's security issue to `security#1`.
- The SKILL.md domain table names exactly one owner for a cloud security issue.
- In-flight work at the time of the ruling is not moved mid-flight: objectstack-ai/cloud PR #3726 (for cloud#3720) finishes under the seat that dispatched it; cloud#3727 was handed to the cloud lane on the ruling.
- Governed surface (`.claude/**`): lands on the maintainer's approval.
